notes: IMPORTANT LIMITATION: this covers state-government employees only. Mississippi has no private-sector leave, holiday-pay or paid-sick-leave statute; private-sector unpaid family and medical leave is federal (FMLA, 29 U.S.C. ch. 28). Listed rather than gapped because it is the only leave-entitlement statute Mississippi has. As-at date not captured (CAPTCHA, see access_notes).
